integrity: All conclusions trace to the given exact algebra and two cited primary theorems. Finite code checks supplement, not replace, proof. No authorship or independent validation is implied.
scientific_limitations: The all-dimensional assertion is for the first gamma coefficient only. Full gamma-vector simplex minimality is established only through dimension four. A degree-five gamma-word coefficient is negative, so the elementary termwise cd-index argument alone does not settle higher dimensions. Earlier observations not indexed in consulted sources remain a priority risk.
title: The first augmented-Chow gamma coefficient from ordinary face numbers, and simplex minimality through dimension four
